content.text:
I fixed the contact page. The form fields had lost the space between them: `.form-field` in `site/css/components.css` had `margin-bottom: 0`, so the fields were bunched together. I set it back to `var(--space-4)`, which is 16px. That restores the roughly 80px of height the page was missing.

The full Playwright run now passes, 28 of 28. That includes the desktop and phone contact screenshots that were failing before.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what the last change was. I worked out the cause from the screenshot diffs, and I haven't confirmed it was the change that introduced the problem.

STATUS: DONE
